Name: Fix Android photo upload crash
Description: Investigate and fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback on Android 14 caused by backgrounding the app mid-upload. Complete the fix and verification by Wednesday to allow QA testing before the August 20th release.

Name: Verify Android photo upload fix
Description: Confirm the fix for the Android 14 photo upload crash on test devices as part of the regression run once the code is landed.

Name: Implement backend sync API for offline notes
Description: Build the sync API endpoint that accepts a last-synced timestamp and returns deltas for created, updated, and deleted notes. Implement last-write-wins conflict resolution. Submit for review before Elena's absence on August 17th and 18th.

Name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes
Description: Implement local caching using Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them upon reconnection. Document acceptance criteria: app usable in airplane mode, edits reconciled online with no data loss.

Name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
Description: Finish building test and release pipelines in GitHub Actions. Run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week to ensure stability before decommissioning Jenkins. Maintain nightly build schedule.

Name: Implement rate limiting for search endpoint
Description: Add per-user rate limiting (100 requests per minute) to the search endpoint. Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when limit is exceeded. Add metrics counters to track limit hits.

Name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
Description: Rebuild the consent screen to meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Implement opt-in consent with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, ensuring no options are pre-checked. Coordinate with legal for copy. Must be included in the August 20th release.

Name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
Description: Create regression tests for purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths in the payments flow. Integrate these tests into CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
